subcommittees.name: Economic Development, Public Buildings, and Emergency Management Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects regions, local communities, economic development organizations, and manufacturers seeking federal public works, planning, and adjustment grants.
dimensions.evidence: facilitate the relocation, to the United States, of a source of employment located outside the United States; and ... facilitate the growth of the manufacturing sector.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies eligibility criteria for existing grant programs without creating entirely new funding amounts or direct individual mandates.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Public Works and Economic Development Act of 1965 to provide for certain grant eligibility relating to projects

dimensions.assessment: Directs existing Economic Development Administration grant programs toward manufacturing and domestic relocation projects without stating a new aggregate appropriation.
dimensions.evidence: Section 201(c) of the Public Works and Economic Development Act of 1965 (42 U.S.C. 3141(c)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of the Public Works and Economic Development Act of 1965 to add specific manufacturing and relocation project categories.
dimensions.evidence: Section 201(c), Section 203(a), Section 207(a)(2), and Section 209(a) of the Public Works and Economic Development Act of 1965

dimensions.assessment: Makes permanent statutory changes to the eligibility rules governing ongoing federal economic development grant programs.

missing_information: Total funding authorization amounts or monetary caps for the modified grant categories are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill expands existing Economic Development Administration grant criteria to include projects facilitating domestic job relocation and manufacturing growth.
